zh-CN:
更新内容
• 新增音频核心 AudioPlayer：基于 FFmpeg 解码与自研 WASAPI/ASIO 互操作实现，NativeAOT 单文件发布，整体替换原 BASS 播放引擎
• 新增 DSP 音效设置页：支持整曲响度归一化（LUFS 目标与前置余量）、左右平衡、声道互换、单声道、耳机交叉馈送、立体声宽度，含 DSP 总开关
• 重写均衡器：拆分为独立控件，新增 Q 值参数、预设持久化与 IPC 同步设置
• 格式转换改回 FFmpeg 引擎：替代 BASS 编码器，支持 WAV/FLAC/MP3/OGG/Opus/AAC/WMA/ALAC 等更多格式输出，可指定有损码率
• 重构 USB 设备写入模块，支持使用 FFmpeg 写入元数据
• 新增桌面歌词相关全局快捷键：显示/隐藏、锁定、卡拉 OK 模式、重置
• 音频处理管线升级为 64 位浮点，音质与精度提升
• 独占输出切换时改为增量重建，避免整段重建导致的卡顿
• 跟随系统文本缩放设置自适应界面大小
• 名称排序统一改用 CJK 拼音比较器，修复中文按 Unicode 码点排序的问题
en:
Release Notes
• New audio core: FFmpeg-based decoder with custom WASAPI/ASIO interop, NativeAOT single-file publish, replaces the original BASS engine
• New DSP settings page: track-level loudness normalization (LUFS target & headroom), channel balance, channel swap, mono downmix, headphone crossfeed, stereo width, plus a master DSP toggle
• Equalizer rewritten as a standalone control with Q-factor support, preset persistence, and IPC-synchronized settings
• Format converter switched back to an FFmpeg-based engine (replacing BASS encoders), with broader output support including WAV/FLAC/MP3/OGG/Opus/AAC/WMA/ALAC and configurable lossy bitrate
• USB device writer module refactored to write metadata via FFmpeg
• New global shortcuts for desktop lyrics: show/hide, lock, karaoke mode, reset position
• Audio processing pipeline upgraded to 64-bit floating point for higher fidelity and precision
• Exclusive output format/device switches now use incremental rebuilds instead of full session rebuilds to avoid glitches
• Interface adapts to the system text-scale accessibility setting
• Sorting unified on a CJK pinyin comparer, fixing Chinese names being ordered by Unicode code points
